target_claim: Suppose G = (V, E) is a connected graph with weighted edges. Establish that for any cycle in G, the maximum-weight edge of that cycle is not included in the minimum spanning tree of G.
source_quote: Suppose G = (V, E) is a connected graph with weighted edges. Establish that for any cycle in G, the maximum-weight edge of that cycle is not included in the minimum spanning tree of G.
